summary: Verified the FeeInfoTip (ⓘ info tooltip) fix on the customer-facing Checkout 'Price details' section. Logged in as demo customer, added Full-time Maid, stepped through Services → Details → Schedule → Your Info → Summary. The ⓘ icons appear next to both 'Platform fee' and 'Est. Govt. Taxes' rows in both the main Price details card and the right-side 'Your order' sidebar. Hovering reveals the admin-configured tooltip text.
